summary: Computes wheel contact friction and spawns surface particles. Gates on the scoring flag dword_8AB6E4 via ArithmeticComparison_9fb0, measures the motion delta a3 against the stored contact frame at a2+72/76/80, and proceeds only when its squared magnitude exceeds 0.010000001. Builds normalized perpendicular friction vectors into the 7-float payload v33, then — when the magnitude is below 400.0 — iterates the contact slots (slot count at this+0x3C, slot array at this+0x40); each slot's +4 surface type selects a color/size packing (6, 7, or 8) and triggers WheelContactParticle. Finally commits the payload to a2+72 and the three packed colors to a2+100/104/108.

operations.description: Outer gate: ArithmeticComparison_9fb0 on the scoring flag global dword_8AB6E4 (0x008AB6E4) must pass before any contact processing runs.
Compute the per-axis difference between the motion vector a3 and the stored contact frame at a2+72/76/80, then its squared magnitude v11; the friction path only runs when v11 > 0.010000001.
Normalize the delta by 1.0/sqrt(v11) scaled by the factor at a2+24 and build the perpendicular friction vectors stored into payload v33[3], v33[4], v33[5].
The detailed per-slot particle path only runs when the squared magnitude is below 400.0 (v11 < 400.0); otherwise the frame is committed without spawning.
guard:3 — iterate the contact slots only when the slot count this[15] (this+0x3C) is greater than 0.
Walk the contact slot array at this+0x40; each slot is a pointer whose +4 dword holds the surface type, and iteration is bounded by the slot count at this+0x3C.
guard:0 — if the slot's surface type (slot+4, flattened as *(this+0x40)+4) equals 6, fall through to the grass/dirt particle path and break the loop.
guard:1 — if the surface type equals 7, pack color ((a2+32)*254.0 << 24) + 0xFFFFFF into v38; skip the particle when both the previous and new colors are 0xFFFFFF.
guard:2 — if the surface type equals 8, pack color ((a2+36)*63.5 << 24) + 0xFFFFFF into v23; skip the particle when both the previous and new colors are 0xFFFFFF.
Spawn WheelContactParticle (callee 0x004CD6C0) for the selected slot with the slot contact v17, the scaled color/size value, the contact frame pointer v8, and the 7-float payload v33.
After the slot loop, commit: copy the 28-byte payload v33 into the contact frame at a2+72 and write the three packed colors v34/v38/v23 to a2+100/+104/+108.
